title: Idle Base and Offline Earnings in Void Swarm, Explained
subtitle: How Scrap, Research Points, prestige and Void Cores fit together, and how to get the most out of them.
description: How do idle base and offline earnings work in Void Swarm? Buildings, Scrap, Research Points, Void Cores, prestige and rewarded boosts explained simply.
card: How the Void Swarm idle base works: buildings, offline earnings, research, prestige for Void Cores, Ascension and the optional boosts.

faq.q: Does Void Swarm earn while the game is closed?
faq.a: Yes. Buildings produce Scrap and Research Points every second, including while you are away. When you return you collect the offline earnings, and for absences of at least five minutes a rewarded ad can triple them.

faq.q: What does prestige do in Void Swarm?
faq.a: Prestige resets your Scrap-paid buildings in exchange for Void Cores, which multiply your production. Ascension goes deeper, resetting more for Ascension Shards and permanent perks. Both are optional and come after the early game.

faq.q: Can I store more offline earnings?
faq.a: Yes. The research tree has upgrades that raise your offline hours, so the base can store a longer absence. Spending Research Points there is a good idea if you often leave the game for many hours.
